description: Companions: prepare (unsigned) a mint in ETH, price read live from the contract. Pass `pick` (a type id from companion_info) to choose the companion, or leave it out for a random pull (public window only). Before the public window only Override Disk holders and ranked Stash wallets may pick, up to the tier their rank allows; refused with the reason when the drop is closed, sold out, gated, the type is gone or the wallet cannot afford it. The wallet is simulated; the contract refunds anything above the price. You sign and send it yourself.

pick.description: Optional: the companion type id (0 to typesCount minus 1, see companion_info). Omit for a random pull.

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and pick rights, and to simulate.

name: prepare_mint_companion
